prose: Short note from the feed listing only: Bloomberg reports that computer science programs are losing students as AI replaces the jobs those degrees once pointed to. The source is paywalled, so the enrollment data, geographies and timeframes behind the headline are unverified here.
highlights: Bloomberg: CS programs lose students as AI replaces jobs
Paywalled - the underlying enrollment numbers are unverified
If it holds, a leading indicator for the tech labor pipeline
